description: Rank Hyperliquid wallets with the full risk set, by `view`. `ranking`: precomputed per-window metrics sorted on any of 20 keys (PnL, ROI, win rate, Calmar, profit factor, drawdown, streaks, ...), filtered by cohort and by minimum trades / win rate / volume, cursor-paged. A window is what was REALIZED in it (the trades closed in it) and a wallet needs 3 closed trades in it unless `min_trades` says otherwise (0 = no floor). `flow_adjusted`: ranks FILLS-DERIVED realized trading PnL, which excludes deposits by construction, with deposits, withdrawals and daily attribution returned beside it, both of the NATIVE perp account only (`flow_unbalanced` marks rows whose attributed block is off the fills; `attributed` and `flow_unbalanced` are null for a wallet now in unified or portfolio-margin mode, whose native account follows margin). `account_value` and `roi` use the wallet's whole value in those two modes, which read null on the drawdown fields; `perp_account_value` and `account_mode` show the native account and the mode. UNITS differ from hl_perp_top_traders: here `win_rate` and `min_win_rate` are FRACTIONS (0.6 = 60%), there percents; `max_drawdown_pct` and `pnl_pct` are percents, and `pnl_pct` is null under $1 of equity (prefer it to the raw `roi`); money is USD. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/leaderboard and /leaderboard/flow-adjusted.

axis.description: Cohort ladder: `size` = account-value tiers in USD, `pnl` = percentile rank of cumulative realized PnL (NOT dollars), `pnl_abs` = dollar bands of that same PnL. Selects the ladder `cohort` filters on. Used by view: ranking.

cohort.description: One label on `axis`, spelled exactly as `hl_segments` view=cohorts lists it, e.g. `whale` (size) or `3x smart` (pnl). Omit for no cohort filter. Used by view: ranking.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. Resend the same window / sort / order / axis / cohort with it.

min_trades.description: Minimum closed trades in the window. Default 3, the floor hl_perp_top_traders applies; pass 0 for no floor (view `flow_adjusted` then still needs at least one).

min_volume.description: Minimum total volume in USD. Used by view: ranking.

min_win_rate.description: Minimum win rate as a FRACTION from 0 to 1 (0.6 = 60%), compared with the `win_rate` the rows show; 60 is refused, not read as 60%. hl_perp_top_traders takes a percent instead. Max 1. Used by view: ranking.

order.description: `desc` (best first) or `asc`. Used by view: ranking.

sort.description: Ranking metric; an unknown key is refused, never replaced by a default. Used by view: ranking.

view.description: What to read. `ranking`: traders ranked on any of 20 metrics with the full risk set. `flow_adjusted`: traders ranked on fills-derived trading PnL, deposits reported beside it. Default `ranking`.

window.description: Window: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`. The trades CLOSED in the current UTC day and the 1, 7, 30 or 365 days before it: PnL, trade counts, win rates and tags are what was realized in it.
